title: Variants of the Damascus inequality
summary: In 2016, Dannan and Sitnik established the notable Damascus inequality, which features a symmetric structure under a multiplicative constraint. In this study, we consider the natural generalisation of this inequality by characterising all positive integers $m$ and $n$ such that the inequality \[\sum_{j=1}^m\frac{x_j^n-1}{x_{j}^{n+1}+1}\leqslant 0\] holds for any positive real numbers $x_1, \ldots, x_m$ with $\prod_{j=1}^mx_j=1$.
